description: PB-43 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Samrala sub-division in the Ludhiana district of Punjab. This office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the local jurisdiction. It plays a crucial role in regulating road safety and transport services within the Samrala region.
address: SDM Office, Ludhiana Road, Near Bus Stand, Samrala, Punjab - 141114
